import.title: Import products from CSV
import.description: Products are matched by SKU. Nothing is saved until you confirm the preview.
import.fileHelp: A .csv file with a header row. Required columns: Name, SKU, Sell price. Optional: Barcode, Category, Cost price, Tax %, Stock. Excel files: use File → Save As → CSV.
import.noRows: The file has no product rows under the header.
import.missingColumns_one: Missing column: {{columns}}. Download the template to see the expected headers.
import.missingColumns_other: Missing columns: {{columns}}. Download the template to see the expected headers.
import.summary: {{file}}: {{created}} new, {{updated}} matching existing SKUs, {{errors}} with errors.
import.updateExisting: Update existing products with a matching SKU
import.updateExistingHint: Columns left blank keep their current values.
import.createCategoriesHint: Otherwise rows with an unknown category are skipped.
import.stockAt: Stock column sets the quantity at
import.showingFirst: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} rows; all of them will be imported.
import.errorsSkipped: Rows with errors are skipped and listed afterwards.

errors.duplicateSku: SKU appears earlier in the file
errors.stock: {{field}} "{{value}}" must be a whole number, 0 or more

checkTax: Choose this product's tax by name: open it and pick a tax rate, or exempt with a reason.

categories.title: Categories
categories.hint: Add, rename or delete categories. Deleting one moves its products to another category, or leaves them without one.
